title: Inama Yanditswe mu Buhanga
intro: Tekereza uhagaze iruhande rw'umuntu uzwiho kuba atari ibitangaza cyangwa ubwami, ahubwo azwiho amagambo akiyobora imitima n'uyu munsi. Uyu mugaragu wa Allah yahawe impano y'agaciro kandi yashyize ishimwe muri buri nama yahawe umunyeshuri ukiri muto ukundwa.
clues: Nahawe umugisha n'Imana wo kugira ubwenge, kandi nategetswe kubushimira.
Navuganye n'umuhungu wanjye mu buryo bwuje ubwuzu, muburira mu rukundo no mu kwita ku bandi.
Nabwiye umuhungu wanjye ko kwishyira hamwe n'Imana ari ikosa rikomeye cyane.
Nagiriye umuhungu wanjye inama yo gukomeza isengesho, gutegeka icyiza, kubuza ikibi, no kwihangana.
Naburiye umuhungu wanjye kutahindukira umusaya kubera ubwibone cyangwa ngo atembagaze ku butaka kubera ubwibone.
Nigishije umuhungu wanjye kuba umuntu ushyira mu gaciro mu muvuduko no kugabanya ijwi, kuko ijwi rikaze cyane ari iry'indogobe.

trial.label: Umujyanama wanjye ukomeye
options: Kugira inama umwana wanjye ku birebana no kwivanga n'Imana
Kubaka ubwato kugira ngo burokoke umwuzure ukomeye
Gusobanura inzozi z'umutegetsi igihe yari muri gereza
trial.answer: Kugira inama umwana wanjye ku birebana no kwivanga n'Imana

location.label: Impano nahawe
options: Intebe y'ubwami itwarwa mu kanya nk'ako guhumbya

outcome.label: Uko nibukwa
options: Nk'uko umuntu yarohamye mu myuzure kubera kutizera
Nk'icyitegererezo cy'ishimwe n'inama z'ababyeyi zirangwa n'ubwenge
Nk'umuntu washenywe n'igisasu gikomeye cyaturutse mu ijuru
outcome.answer: Nk'icyitegererezo cy'ishimwe n'inama z'ababyeyi zirangwa n'ubwenge

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
